text:
maria (AE): Quick heads up  NovaHealth procurement wants an emergency reply: they found a line in our SOW that references 'no HSM attestation'. Legal flagged it as a blocker and asked if we can provide a signed clarification. They also want committed throughput tiers defined for the pilot. Can we turn this around today?
neil (Solutions Eng): Which tiers do they want? Typical pilot tiers: 250rps, 1k rps, 3k rps. We can propose 1k rps sustained with bursts to 2.5k and an optional growth plan. Need model and quantization though.
maria (AE): They're starting with 7B quantized model. They want explicit failover to hosted in the event of degraded dedicated performance and runtime tracer logs accessible for 30 days.
sophie (Security): We don't ship attestation letters for HSM by default. We can provide SOC2 + key lifecycle docs. Offer: signed controls attestation and a paragraph clarifying the SOW wording.
alan (VP Sales): Alan here: Fine to provide clarification letter. Don't overpromise new attestations. For throughput tiers and pricing, propose a 3mo pilot with committed credits and a performance clause. If they need 99.95% SLA, add the staged approach.
neil (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the pilot tiers and the failover clause. Example fallback policy to include:
```
fallback:
  primary: dedicated-pool-nova
  fallback: hosted-redwood-7b
  fallback-trigger: p95_latency>1200ms or error_rate>1% for 5m
```
deploy-bot: Reminder: raise ticket NH-2104 for NovaHealth SOW clarification (assignee: neil).
maria (AE): Neil, can you own the SOW clarification text + pilot tiers by 3pm PT? Sophie, legal wants a short signed controls attestation doc, can you draft and I'll route to alan for sign-off?
sophie (Security): Drafting now. Two quick asks: (1) confirm audit log export format they need (JSON/CSV) (2) rotation frequency expectations for BYOK.
maria (AE): I'll confirm both with the customer and update. Action items summary: neil  pilot tiers and SOW clarification by 3pm PT (NH-2104). sophie  controls attestation draft and log/export options by 2pm PT. alan  review & sign if OK.
alan (VP Sales): If procurement pushes pricing, escalate to execs. Keep me posted.
maria (AE): Thanks all, will post updates in NH-2104.
